title: Grateful Dead Live at Compton Terrace Amphitheatre on 1982-07-25
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi Dragon > ART DI/O > Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe soundcard > Cool Edit 2000 > flac encoding > FLAC

ai_review.summary: A stellar audience recording captures a high‑energy 1982 summer show featuring smoking Franklin’s Tower, Sailor > Saint and a heavyweight Estimated Prophet.
ai_review.review: The audience tape is praised as crystal‑clear and immersive, delivering the feeling of being right in the venue. The band was on fire—both sets are described as “sick‑o,” with standout moments on Franklin’s Tower, Sailor > Saint and an especially heavy Estimated Prophet. Overall it’s regarded as one of the top shows of 1982.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are highly positive (average 4.8★) and consistently praise both the musical performance and the audience recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers call the tape "out of this world" and "amazing," noting crystal‑clear crowd capture with no reported dropouts or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Both sets flow tightly and maintain a high‑octane vibe; transitions are seamless and the energy never wanes.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Fumbles three verses on Franklin's Tower but his instrumental work with Brent is highlighted as amazing.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (and Keith) deliver a heavy, standout Estimated Prophet and strong interplay with Jerry's guitar.
